How: A kitchen or parcel scale, a tape measure, and the bag or box you will really use.
Rule or check: Do not guess the weight by holding it. A scale costs less than one wrong label.
Demo example (Fernmoor wool cardigan, ma: Kitchen scale, soft tape measure, grey poly mailer bag 35 x 45 cm

How: Clothing: a poly mailer bag or a paper mailer. Shoes, bags, heavy or stiff items: a box.
Rule or check: The item should fit with a little room, not a box that is half air.
Demo example (Fernmoor wool cardigan, ma: Poly mailer bag (no box needed for a soft knit)

What to do: Pack the item before you list
How: Fold the item flat, put it in a clear bag if the mailer is not waterproof, seal the mailer.
Rule or check: Weigh and measure the parcel as it will be sent. Not the item alone.
Demo example (Fernmoor wool cardigan, ma: Cardigan folded into a 30 x 25 cm rectangle, in a clear bag, inside the mailer

How: Put the sealed parcel on the scale. Write the number down.
Rule or check: Include the bag or box, tissue, filling and any note or invoice.

How: Round up to the next 100 g (or the next whole unit your carrier uses).
Rule or check: Never round down. A parcel 10 g over the limit counts as the next size.

How: The longest side. Round up to the next whole cm (or inch).
Rule or check: Measure the outside of the parcel at its widest point.

How: The next longest side. Round up.
Rule or check: Soft mailers bulge in the middle, so measure there.

How: From the table to the highest point. Round up.
Rule or check: Press lightly like a carrier would. Do not squash it to make it fit.

How: Length x width x height in cm, divided by your carrier's number (many couriers use 5000 for cm and kg).
Rule or check: Many couriers charge the bigger of the real weight and this number. Postal services often charge small soft parcels by real weight only. Check your carrier.
Demo example (Fernmoor wool cardigan, ma: 31 x 26 x 6 = 4836, / 5000 = about 1 kg. Real weight 0.6 kg. A courier using this rule would charge for 1 kg.

What to do: Pick the parcel size when you list
How: Vinted shows each parcel size with its weight limit and examples for your country. Pick the smallest size where your packed weight and size are both under the limit.
Rule or check: Limits differ by country and carrier. Check the app every time, they change.
Demo example (Fernmoor wool cardigan, ma: Smallest size whose limit is above 0.6 kg and fits 31 x 26 x 6 cm

What to do: Do not pick a size too small
How: If you are close to a limit, pick the next size up.
Rule or check: The carrier can refuse the parcel or charge extra. After the buyer pays, the size cannot be changed.
Demo example (Fernmoor wool cardigan, ma: 0.6 kg is well under the limit: no need to go up

How: Before you agree to a bundle, pack and weigh the items together.
Rule or check: A bundle often needs a bigger parcel than one item. Tell the buyer before they pay if it does.
Demo example (Fernmoor wool cardigan, ma: Cardigan + scarf bundle: 0.75 kg packed. Still under the same limit

How: After the sale, use the label or code from Vinted and the carrier the buyer picked. Ship within the time Vinted shows (5 working days when this was written).
Rule or check: Miss the deadline or use another carrier and the order can be cancelled and refunded.
Demo example (Fernmoor wool cardigan, ma: Dropped off at the buyer's chosen point 1 day after the sale

What to do: Enter the package details when you list
How: In the delivery part of the listing, enter the packed weight and the length, width and height. For calculated postage these numbers set what the buyer pays.
Rule or check: Use your rounded-up numbers from steps 5 to 8.

What to do: Choose the package type and service
How: Pick the package type and a service whose size and weight limits your parcel fits, for example a large letter, small parcel or package option.
Rule or check: Read the carrier's maximum size and weight for that service before you choose it.
Demo example (Fernmoor wool cardigan, ma: Small parcel or package service with tracking

How: The number of working days you need to post after payment. Pick one you can always meet.
Rule or check: Late posting can hurt your seller rating.

What to do: Buy the label with the real numbers
How: If you buy postage on eBay, the weight and size on the label must match the parcel.
Rule or check: If the carrier finds a bigger or heavier parcel, you can be charged the difference after.
Demo example (Fernmoor wool cardigan, ma: Label bought for 0.6 kg and 31 x 26 x 6 cm

How: Old labels and barcodes removed or covered, label flat and fully visible, parcel sealed on all edges.
Rule or check: Old barcodes on reused bags or boxes can send the parcel to the wrong place.
Demo example (Fernmoor wool cardigan, ma: New mailer, label on the flat front, no old barcodes
